_metadata.bootstrap_source: v3.4.5 migration from v3.4.0-3.4.4.1 data/*.yaml; original entries preserved verbatim
_metadata.description: Frontier inference model registry. open_models feeds frontier_kv computation. closed_models excluded from frontier calc (architecture unknown) but Sonnet may reference them in narrative. Auto-updated by src/analysis/dhcr_arch_aggregator.py.

open_models.name: Llama 2 70B
open_models.notes: Frontier open model at end-2023. GQA was already mainstream in Llama 2 70B.

open_models.name: Mistral 8x22B (Mixtral Large)
open_models.notes: MoE doesn't multiply KV cache (shared across experts at inference).

open_models.name: Llama 3 70B
open_models.notes: Same arch as Llama 2 70B. Improvements were in training data + recipe.

open_models.name: Llama 3.1 70B (FP8)
open_models.notes: FP8 inference cuts KV cache by 2x with minimal quality loss.

open_models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (FP8)
open_models.notes: Frontier scale but more layers → larger KV than 70B variants.

open_models.name: DeepSeek V2
open_models.notes: First production MLA. ~93% KV reduction vs MHA-equivalent at same dim.

open_models.name: DeepSeek V3
open_models.notes: MLA + FP8. The frontier-efficient baseline at start of 2025.

open_models.name: Qwen 2.5 72B
open_models.notes: GQA + FP8 baseline. Not a frontier-efficiency move.

open_models.name: Llama 4 Maverick
open_models.notes: Stuck with GQA. Did NOT adopt MLA — Meta opted for proven arch + bigger context window.

open_models.name: DeepSeek V3.5
open_models.notes: MLA + FP8 + sliding-window context compression. Frontier efficiency.

open_models.name: Qwen 3 235B (MLA + FP8)
open_models.notes: Alibaba adopted MLA in Qwen 3. Validates MLA as standard for efficient frontier.

open_models.name: DeepSeek V4 (estimated)
open_models.notes: MLA + INT4 KV + sliding-window. Current frontier efficiency as of May 2026.

closed_models.name: GPT-5
closed_models.estimation_method: cost-per-token gradient at long context + throughput curves vs known peers
closed_models.notes: Cost-per-million-output at 128K is 1.18x cost at 8K — suggests moderate KV (~40 KB). Not MLA-class.

closed_models.name: Claude 4 Opus
closed_models.estimation_method: throughput at 200K vs known GQA models
closed_models.notes: Anthropic does NOT publicly disclose. Estimate based on price curves + throughput.

closed_models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
closed_models.notes: Google has been most aggressive on long context. May have proprietary attention compression.

deepseek v3.name: DeepSeek V3
deepseek v3.notes: DeepSeek R1 (released 2025-01-20) is identical architecture (same MLA params, same MoE config) trained via RL on V3 base; consolidated as single entry per Part 2 same-architecture rule, using V3 as representative. V3-0324 and V3.5 are also same arch line; V3 (original) used here as it is the production-validated FP8 checkpoint. kv_lora_rank=512 and qk_rope_head_dim=64 sourced from HuggingFace transformers DeepSeek-V3 config defaults matching the official deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 repo.

llama 4 scout.name: Llama 4 Scout
llama 4 scout.notes: Scout released as BF16 weights (lab's validated production precision); 17B active params, 16 experts, 109B total. num_hidden_layers=48, num_key_value_heads=8, head_dim=128 from HuggingFace Llama4 model doc defaults (identical to meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct config). Separate entry from Maverick per different expert count and distinct deployment tier.

llama 4 maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama 4 maverick.notes: Maverick released in both BF16 and FP8; FP8 is the lab-validated production serving format (fits single H100 DGX host); 17B active params, 128 experts (+1 shared), 400B total; alternating dense and MoE layers. Same num_layers/kv_heads/head_dim as Scout but different expert count and precision, making it a separate entry.

qwen3 235b a22b.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
qwen3 235b a22b.notes: num_layers=94, 64 Q heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim=128 confirmed from official Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B HuggingFace model card; 235B total, 22B active, 128 experts (8 active per token); BF16 is the lab-released precision; Qwen3-30B-A3B is a different size class and excluded as smaller/lower benchmark rank.

qwen3 32b.name: Qwen3-32B
qwen3 32b.notes: Dense 32B model; 64 layers, 64 Q heads, 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim=128 confirmed from apxml.com spec cross-referencing Qwen3 HF config defaults; separate entry from Qwen3-235B-A22B per Part 2 (different num_layers and architecture: dense vs MoE).

mistral small 3.1 24b.name: Mistral Small 3.1 24B
mistral small 3.1 24b.notes: Layers=40, num_kv_heads=8, head_dim=128 from NVIDIA NIM model card (Mistral Small 3 / 2501 spec, unchanged in 3.1 architecture) and HuggingFace forum config disclosure; Mistral Small 3.2 (2506) has identical architecture per lab disclosure — using 3.1 as the most-cited benchmark-present representative; BF16 is the primary release precision (~55 GB GPU RAM per HF page).

gemma 3 27b.name: Gemma 3 27B
gemma 3 27b.notes: num_hidden_layers=62, num_key_value_heads=16, head_dim=128 sourced from config.json dump in google/gemma-3-27b-it HuggingFace discussion thread; model uses 5:1 local-to-global attention ratio which reduces effective long-context KV in practice, but formula is applied uniformly across all 62 layers per Part 3 instructions; BF16 is lab release precision (torch_dtype=bfloat16 in config).

excluded_by_prompt.name: DeepSeek R1
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Identical architecture to DeepSeek V3 (same num_layers=61, same MLA params, same MoE config); consolidated into V3 entry per Part 2 same-architecture rule.

excluded_by_prompt.name: DeepSeek V3-0324
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Same architecture as DeepSeek V3 (same MLA/MoE config); consolidated into V3 entry per Part 2 same-architecture rule.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Architecture identical to Mistral Small 3.1 per lab disclosure ('architecture is identical — migration is a model-identifier swap'); consolidated into Mistral Small 3.1 entry per Part 2 same-architecture rule.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Smaller MoE variant in same Qwen3 release; lower benchmark rank than Qwen3-235B-A22B and Qwen3-32B in its class; excluded to avoid redundancy within same release date family where larger variants dominate leaderboards.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Llama 4 Behemoth
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Research-only preview — no production weights released as of 2026-05-25; fails Part 1 criterion (research-only models with no production weights released).

excluded_by_prompt.name: GLM-4 / GLM-Z1 (Z.ai)
excluded_by_prompt.reason: No confirmed benchmark presence in MMLU-Pro top-30, LiveBench top-30, Artificial Analysis top-30, or lmarena.ai Hard prompts top-30 for open-weights variants released after 2024-12-01; fails Part 1B benchmark presence criterion.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Grok open-weights (xAI)
excluded_by_prompt.reason: No open-weight model from xAI released between 2024-12-01 and 2026-05-25 confirmed with production weights and top-30 benchmark presence; Grok-3 weights not publicly released as of 2026-05-25.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Gemma 3 1B / 4B / 12B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Smaller size classes; not in top-30 of relevant benchmarks in competition with frontier models from other labs.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Qwen2.5-72B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Released before 2024-12-01 cutoff (released September 2024); fails Part 1 date criterion.

excluded_by_prompt.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen / Llama variants
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Fine-tunes of other labs' base models (Qwen2.5 / Llama3 bases); explicitly excluded per Part 1 exclusion criteria.

deepseek v3.name: DeepSeek-V3
deepseek v3.notes: Paper-stated KV: ACM ISCA 2025 companion paper (arXiv:2505.09343) states 70 KB/token at BF16 for DeepSeek-V3; at FP8 this halves to ~35 KB/token, closely matching computed 34.3 KB; the 70 KB BF16 figure used above as paper_stated (×2 bytes) gives 68.36 KB; V3-0324 shares same base architecture per DeepSeek changelog; V3 line used as representative (same arch as V3-0324).

llama 4 scout.name: Llama 4 Scout
llama 4 scout.notes: Config confirmed from HF transformers docs: num_hidden_layers=48, num_key_value_heads=8, head_dim=128; Scout released BF16 only (no lab-published FP8); iRoPE hybrid attention (NoPE every 4th layer) does not change KV tensor dimensions per layer, only positional encoding.

llama 4 maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama 4 maverick.notes: Same transformer config as Scout (48 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim=128); Maverick officially released in both BF16 and FP8 per Meta model card; FP8 used as lowest lab-validated precision; alternating dense+MoE layers do not affect attention/KV dimensions.

qwen3 235b a22b.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
qwen3 235b a22b.notes: Architecture confirmed from official HF model card: 94 layers, GQA 64Q/4KV, 128 experts, 8 activated; lab also publishes Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 but base model is BF16; head_dim derived as hidden_size/num_attention_heads = 7168/56 = 128 (consistent with Qwen2.5 lineage).

gemma 3 27b.name: Gemma 3 27B
gemma 3 27b.notes: Config confirmed from HF discussion thread showing config.json: 62 layers, 32 attn heads, 16 KV heads, head_dim=128; 5:1 local-to-global sliding-window attention (window=1024) means KV cache for the 5/6 local layers is bounded by 1024 tokens, so effective KV at long context is ~6× lower than the GQA full-context formula; reported figure is the theoretical upper bound (all 62 layers global).

mistral small 3.1.name: Mistral Small 3.1
mistral small 3.1.notes: Architecture confirmed by NVIDIA NIM model card for Mistral Small 3 (2501)/3.1: 40 layers, 32 heads, 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim=128; Mistral Small 3.1 shares the same base architecture as Small 3 per official model card; lab-published BF16 weights only (no FP8 training declared).

mistral medium 3.5.name: Mistral Medium 3.5
mistral medium 3.5.notes: Architecture confirmed by NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel docs: 88 Ministral-3 decoder layers, 96 attn heads, 8 KV heads, hidden 12288 → head_dim=12288/96=128; Mistral ships the model in FP8 natively (per RecViking NVFP4 quant readme citing 'Source FP8 model: mistralai/Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B (FP8, per-tensor)'); benchmark coverage is limited as of May 2026 launch date — priority-by-recency rule applies.

excluded_by_prompt.name: DeepSeek-R1
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Reasoning/RL fine-tune initialized from DeepSeek-V3-Base — same architecture as DeepSeek-V3, not a separate architectural entry; Part 2 variant rule: same arch → use most-cited/deployed representative (DeepSeek-V3).

excluded_by_prompt.name: DeepSeek-V3-0324
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Part 2 variant rule: same architecture as DeepSeek-V3 (same base model, improved post-training only per DeepSeek changelog); DeepSeek-V3 retained as representative.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Qwen3-32B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Dense 32B model; architecturally smaller size class than the flagship Qwen3-235B-A22B MoE; does not independently appear in top-30 of listed benchmarks above Qwen3-235B-A22B in the same lookback window.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Smaller MoE variant (30B total) of the Qwen3 family; same architectural family as Qwen3-235B-A22B with different size; not independently the flagship — Qwen3-235B-A22B is the flagship per Alibaba positioning.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Gemma 3 1B / 4B / 12B
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Smaller size variants of Gemma 3 family; not the flagship; Gemma 3 27B is the largest open-weight release in the Gemma 3 series.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Mistral Small 3.2
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Part 2 variant rule: same base architecture as Mistral Small 3.1 (instruct-tuning refinement only, base weights unchanged per official model card); Mistral Small 3.1 used as representative.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Llama 4 Behemoth
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Not released as open weights; still in training/preview as of 2026-05-25 — excluded as research-only/no production weights.

excluded_by_prompt.name: GLM-4 / Z.ai releases
excluded_by_prompt.reason: No architecturally significant open-weights release from Z.ai (GLM family) confirmed between 2024-12-01 and 2026-05-25 that meets benchmark criterion (B); no primary-source technical disclosure found within the lookback window.

excluded_by_prompt.name: xAI Grok open-weights
excluded_by_prompt.reason: No open-weights release from xAI confirmed within the 2024-12-01 to 2026-05-25 lookback window; Grok models have been API-only.

excluded_by_prompt.name: Anthropic open-weights
excluded_by_prompt.reason: Anthropic has made no open-weights releases; explicitly listed as 'currently none' in the lab-of-origin criteria.

llama 4 maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama 4 maverick.computation_note: Same KV arch as Llama 3 70B at FP8

deepseek v4 pro.name: DeepSeek V4-Pro
deepseek v4 pro.computation_note: Paper claim: V4-Pro KV cache is ~10% of V3.2 at 1M context → 33 × 0.10 = 3.3 GB/1M. Architecture: CSA/HCA hybrid sparse attention (April 2026 release).
